body.para: Closes databases and the tables that are open in the current data session. This is the FoxPro dialect version of CLOSE DATABASES.
ALLCloses all open databases, including the current database, and all tables, indexes and format files in all work areas of the current data session.
Without the ALL clause the current database is closed, and there will be no current database afterwards. If there is no current database, then all free tables in the current data session are closed.

In both cases all work areas are closed and work area 1 is selected afterwards. Please note that without the ALL clause, X# closes all work areas, also the work areas with tables that do not belong to the current database. In Visual FoxPro only the tables of the current database are closed.
CLOSE, CLOSE TABLES, OPEN DATABASE, SET DATABASE TO
